changes.change: Added new parameterization for MPU l3 cache size configurations - please verify the desired cache size in the Power and Resets tab. Default value for devices with restricted cache sizes are now automatically adjusted.
Fix open drain enable HDL parameter setting for HPS IO output buffers.
Added example design parameters and generation support.
preset reset output interface is now added to the system along with CoreSight debug APB enablement.
HPS RTL simulation model now include ACE5-lite BFM for simulating the fabric fpga2hps bridge.
Fix HPS and EMIF-for-HPS connectivity warnings for missing port drivers.
Fix incorrect label and assignment of parameters for EMAC 50 and 250 MHz clock source.
Fix generated A76 cpu power configurations for DualHPS and Agilex 3 devices.
Fix location assignment for HPS dedicated IOs so that they are no longer ignored by Quartus fitter.
Update legality checks and messages for CPU Application and L3 cache legality.
Update generated RTL for SPIS and TPIU input clocks to correct polarity of the clocks being inverted internally.
Changed SDC generation method and output for HPS constraints.
Add reset synchronizers for hps2fpga, lwhps2fpga, f2sdram, and fpga2hps interface ready latency logic.
Added support for AXI4-Lite based CSR Interface.
